links.outcome: Whether human review corrected gaps in ChatGPT-generated nurse schedules
links.effect: Hybrid 4×10/5×8 schedule met daily coverage and maintained equity but gave no redundancy for absences; human review resolved role-specific gaps.
links.quote: A hybrid 4×10/5×8 model met daily coverage 5 Outpatient Care Center (OCC), 1 Heart Center (HC), and maintained equity, but provided no redundancy for absences; human review resolved role‑specific gaps.

unlisted_practices: iterative prompt engineering with explicit constraint mapping for LLM-generated scheduling

screen.reason: Case study evaluating ChatGPT-4.0 for generating outpatient cardiology nurse schedules using prompt engineering and human oversight, without a comparative test of a specific deployment guardrail.
